documents.title: UN-AUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED 30.09.2026
Board Meeting Outcome for UN-AUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED 30.09.2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Nitin Spinners reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results, highlighting record-high quarterly revenue, exports, and fabric business revenue driven by better demand and higher yarn realizations. Management noted that ongoing brownfield expansions are in advanced stages with trial production commenced, aiming to increase captive yarn consumption and margin profiles. The company continues to focus on value-added products, renewable energy integration, and cost-efficiency measures supported by state government policy benefits. Furthermore, strategic growth levers such as FTA-ready global reach and disciplined capex are expected to sustain profitable and sustainable growth in the future. Nitin Spinners reported its highest ever quarterly revenue of INR875 crores for Q1 FY27, driven by improved yarn realizations, better demand environment, and optimum capacity utilization.

guidance.claim: The company aims to deliver profitable and sustainable growth in the year ahead.
guidance.quote: With favourable trade policies, an expanding presence in value-added fabrics, a well-diversified export footprint and an increasing share of renewable energy in our energy mix, we are well positioned to sustain this momentum and deliver profitable and sustainable growth in the year ahead.

guidance.claim: The company guided that its blended margins should remain in the range of 16% to 20%.
guidance.quote: I guided or have informed that the kind of product mix which our company has, we should be in the range of 16% to 20%.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of delivering year-on-year growth for the full year FY27 supported by commercialization of additional capacities.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we remain confident of delivering year-on-year growth for the full year FY27, supported by the commercialization of our additional capacities of fabric and yarn, which will further strengthen our manufacturing capabilities, improve profitability, and support sustainable long-term growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports contributed 68% to quarterly revenue, driven by better demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Exports contributed 68% to the quarterly revenue, driven by better demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Management anticipates that demand for fabric and yarn will continue to be better, supported by downstream growth and industry consolidation.
demand_outlook.quote: We anticipate that the demand for fabric and yarn will continue to be better, supported by demand coming from growth across the downstream sector and the consolidation of the spinning industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The fabric business witnessed a stable pricing environment compared to the previous quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: The fabric business witnessed a stable pricing environment compared to the previous quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Cotton prices increased during quarter 1 by about 8% to 10%, primarily driven by overall lower global production, global supply chain and logistics challenges due to West Asia war.
demand_outlook.quote: Cotton prices increased during quarter 1 by about 8% to 10%, primarily driven by overall lower global production, global supply chain and logistics challenges due to West Asia war.

demand_outlook.claim: The long-term outlook for the Indian textile industry remains positive supported by trade agreements, policy measures, and cotton price parity.
demand_outlook.quote: The long-term outlook for the Indian textile industry remains positive, supported by various trade agreements and policy measures, as well as improved price parity between international and domestic cotton.

demand_outlook.claim: Q1FY27 performance was driven by improved yarn realizations and better demand.
demand_outlook.quote: This performance was driven by improved yarn realizations and better demand.

capex_expansion.claim: Trial production of griege woven fabric has commenced as part of the ongoing brownfield expansion of 35 million metres per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capacity expansion front, we have commenced trial production of griege woven fabric.

capex_expansion.claim: The projects are in the advanced stage of commissioning, with partial trial production already commenced and full commissioning expected by the end of December 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The projects are in the advanced stage of commissioning, with partial trial production already commenced. Full commissioning is expected by the end of December 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity expansion of fabric by another 35 million meters and spinning capacity by additional 74,000 spindles is progressing as scheduled.
capex_expansion.quote: Going forward, our -- one of our future growth driver will be our capacity addition, which is going -- progressing as schedule with the expansion of our fabric capacity by another 35 million meters and spinning capacity by additional 74,000 spindles.

capex_expansion.claim: The renewable power expansion plan is progressing as per schedule and is expected to be operational by the end of Q3 '27.
capex_expansion.quote: The renewable power expansion plan is also going as per schedule and expected to be operational by the end of Q3 '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex plans are progressing in full swing and expected commercial operation from Q3FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex Plans are progressing in full swing and expected commercial operation from Q3FY27

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin was sustained at 17.8%, supported by higher yarn realizations, optimum capacity utilization, and ongoing cost saving measures.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin was sustained at 17.8%, supported by higher yarn realizations, optimum capacity utilization and ongoing cost saving measures.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 17.78%, an increase of 376 bps on a year-on-year basis due to improved realization and cost saving initiatives.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for this quarter stood at 17.78% against Q1 FY26 margins of 14.02% is an increase of 376 bps on a year-on-year basis and 261 bps on quarter-on-quarter basis. That is due to improved realization and cost saving initiatives.

margins_costs.claim: Upon completion of the renewable power expansion, the company expects to reduce power costs further.
margins_costs.quote: Upon completion of the same, we are expected to reduce our power costs further.

margins_costs.claim: Cost savings resulting from energy-saving efforts, automations, and modernizations are permanent in nature and will continue going forward.
margins_costs.quote: So these two things have resulted some automations have also been done which was also a part of our expansion plans. So we have also modernized some of our existing capabilities. So all these three things have resulted in some of our cost savings which is going to continue. These cost savings are permanent in nature and will continue going forward as well.

orders_capacity.claim: In FY27, spinning capacity was operating at 98% utilization and woven fabric over 92% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: In FY27, our spinning capacity was operating at 98% utilization and woven fabric over 92% utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: Knitted fabric capacity utilization is in the range of about 55% to 60% due to uncertainties prevailing in the US market.
orders_capacity.quote: This is in the range of about 55% to 60% at this point of time. We have not yet reached the 65% level the usual utilization pre this US tariff regime used to be around 60% to 65%. We have not yet reached that level due to the various uncertainties which is still prevailing in the US market.

orders_capacity.claim: Current production capacity includes 1.10 Lakh Tons for yarn, 40 Mn Mtr for woven fabric, and 11,000 Tons for knitted fabric.
orders_capacity.quote:
Current Production Capacity
1.10 Lakh Tons 40 Mn Mtr 11,000 Tons
Bhilwara Plant, Rajasthan Chittorgarh Plant , Rajasthan
Yarn Woven Fabric Knitted Fabric

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated it would not be prudent to go for a buyback at this point of time as the company is in a growth phase deploying capital for growth purposes through internal accruals and loans.
capital_allocation.quote: I think at this point of time we are in a growth phase. We are deploying our capital for the growth purposes, internal accruals as well as we are also taking some loans as well. So it would not be some it would not be prudent for us to go for buyback at this point of time.

risks_headwinds.claim: A major presence of the knit fabric business in the US was impacted because of frequent changes in tariff rates and other uncertainties.
risks_headwinds.quote: We had a major presence of our knit fabric business in the US which has impacted because of this a lot of changes which is happening very often in the tariff rates and others.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to risks including fluctuations in earnings, competition, economic growth, and government policies.
risks_headwinds.quote: The risks and uncertainties relating to these statements include, but are not limited to, risks and uncertainties regarding fluctuations in earnings, our ability to manage growth, competition (both domestic and international), economic growth in India and abroad, ability to attract and retain highly skilled professionals, time and cost over runs on contracts, our ability to manage our international operations, government policies and actions regulations, interest and other fiscal costs generally prevailing in the economy.

management_commitments.claim: Full commissioning of the expansion projects is expected by the end of December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Full commissioning is expected by the end of December 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The renewable power expansion plan is expected to be operational by the end of Q3 '27.
management_commitments.quote: The renewable power expansion plan is also going as per schedule and expected to be operational by the end of Q3 '27.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to have ramped up all yarn capacities by 31st of March of the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: I think we would have ramped up all our capacities by 31st of March of this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects commercial operation from the ongoing capex plans starting from Q3FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Capex Plans are progressing in full swing and expected commercial operation from Q3FY27

management_commitments.claim: Management remains confident of delivering year-on-year growth for the full year FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we remain confident of delivering year-on-year growth for the full year FY27, supported by the commercialization of our additional capacities of fabric and yarn, which will further strengthen our manufacturing capabilities, improve profitability, and support sustainable long-term growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
